in_arabic.name: مختومة
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name for a female, derived from the root 'akthama' (أختم), meaning to cover or conceal. It is a variant of the name 'Makhtoum' or 'Makhtoom', which is mentioned in the Quran for a person who was blind.

in_urdu.name: مختومہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: A female name in Urdu, derived from the Arabic word 'makhtooma'. It translates to 'the concealed ones' or 'those who cannot be seen'. It is a variant of the name 'Makhtoum' or 'Makhtoom', which is mentioned in the Quran for a person who was blind.

in_hindi.name: मख्तूमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: A female name in Hindi, derived from the Arabic word 'makhtooma'. It translates to 'the hidden one' or 'the concealed one'. It is a variant of the name 'Makhtoum' or 'Makhtoom', which is mentioned in the Quran for a person who was blind.

in_pashto.name: مختومه
in_pashto.long_meaning: A female name in Pashto, derived from the Arabic word 'makhtooma'. It translates to 'the imprisoned one' or 'the confined one'. It is a variant of the name 'Makhtoum' or 'Makhtoom', which is mentioned in the Quran for a person who was blind.
